finance_export.script:
trigger = Cron(mode='cron', cronExpression='0 7 * * 1')
http = HttpRequest(method='GET', url='https://example.com/export', responseType='json')
trigger >> http

check = If(condition='{{$json.body}}', field='body', operation='isNotEmpty', value='')
http >> check

pg = Postgres(
    connectionString='{{$env.DATABASE_URL}}',
    operation='query',
    query='INSERT INTO finance.ledger (data) VALUES ($1) ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET data = EXCLUDED.data',
    queryParameters='{{$json.body}}'
)
check.true >> pg

stop = StopAndError(errorType='error', message='Export from https://example.com/export returned an empty body; nothing to upsert into finance.ledger.')
check.false >> stop

validate()

cron = Cron(mode="cron", cronExpression="0 7 * * 1")

check = If(field="{{$json.body}}", operation="isNotEmpty", value="")
upsert = Postgres(
    operation="query",
    query="INSERT INTO finance.ledger (data) VALUES ({{$json.body}}) ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET data = EXCLUDED.data",
)
fail = StopAndError(errorType="error", message="Export was empty")

cron >> fetch >> check
check.true >> upsert
check.false >> fail

validate()

cron = Cron(mode="cron", cronExpression="0 7 * * 1")

)

regional_loop_large.script:
start = Cron(mode='cron', cronExpression='0 7 * * 1')

http = HttpRequest(method='GET', url='https://example.com/export', responseType='json')
start >> http

check = If(condition='response body is not empty', field='{{$json.body}}', operation='isNotEmpty', value='')
http >> check

stop = StopAndError(errorType='error', message='Export response was empty; aborting run')
check.false >> stop

regions = ['US', 'CA', 'MX', 'UK', 'DE', 'FR', 'JP', 'AU']
region_nodes = []
for region in regions:
    upsert = Postgres(
        connectionString='{{$env.FINANCE_DB_CONNECTION_STRING}}',
        operation='query',
        query=(
            "INSERT INTO finance.ledger (region, payload) "
            "VALUES ($1, $2) "
            "ON CONFLICT (region) DO UPDATE SET payload = EXCLUDED.payload"
        ),
        queryParameters=[region, '{{$json.body}}'],
    )
    check.true >> upsert
    region_nodes.append(upsert)

validate()

weather_email.script:
cron = Cron(mode="cron", cronExpression="0 6 * * *")
http = HttpRequest(method="GET", url="https://api.weather.example.com/current", responseType="json")
check_empty = If(condition="expression", field="{{$json}}", operation="isEmpty", value="")
stop = StopAndError(errorType="error", message="Weather API returned an empty response")
send_email = SendEmail(toEmail="ops@example.com", subject="Daily weather check", bodyFormat="plain", body="The daily weather check completed successfully.")

cron >> http
http >> check_empty
check_empty.true >> stop
check_empty.false >> send_email

validate()
